evaluator: custom (soccer_tracker.evaluation.ball / .detection); not an official benchmark evaluator

criteria.iou: IoU >= 0.5 with a ground-truth ball box
criteria.dist: centre within one ball diameter (max(gt w, gt h)) of the ground-truth centre

identity_metrics: id_switches reported only for UVY-Track (persistent ball ids); never for InFactory
scored_frames: InFactory: every frame (visible or explicitly 'not visible'). UVY-Track: only frames with a ball row of visibility > 0; UVY-Track never marks the ball absent, and its visibility-0 rows are carried-forward boxes, so those frames are left out. False alarms on ball-free frames are therefore measured on InFactory only.
